changePictureFromFile.label: Change Picture
changePictureFromFile.description: Show another picture from your device in the same frame, keeping its size and formatting.

changePictureFromURL.label: Change Picture From Web
changePictureFromURL.description: Show another picture from the web in the same frame, keeping its size and formatting.

cropOptions.label: Crop
cropOptions.description: Crop the picture to a shape or a proportion, or place it in its frame.

cropToShape.label: Crop to Shape
cropToShape.description: Clip the picture to the outline of a shape, keeping its size and formatting.

cropAspectOptions.label: Aspect Ratio
cropAspectOptions.description: Crop the picture to a proportion.

cropAspect1x1.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 1:1, about its center.

cropAspect2x3.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 2:3, about its center.

cropAspect3x4.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 3:4, about its center.

cropAspect3x5.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 3:5, about its center.

cropAspect4x5.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 4:5, about its center.

cropAspect3x2.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 3:2, about its center.

cropAspect4x3.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 4:3, about its center.

cropAspect5x3.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 5:3, about its center.

cropAspect5x4.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 5:4, about its center.

cropAspect16x9.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 16:9, about its center.

cropAspect16x10.description: Crop the picture to a proportion of 16:10, about its center.

cropFill.label: Fill
cropFill.description: Cover the whole frame with the picture, keeping its proportions. What overflows is cropped.

cropFit.label: Fit
cropFit.description: Show the whole picture inside the frame, keeping its proportions.

pictureHyperlinkOptions.label: Link
pictureHyperlinkOptions.description: Link the picture to a web page, a place in this workbook or an email address.

updatePictureHyperlink.label: Link
updatePictureHyperlink.description: Add or edit the link a click on the picture follows.

openPictureHyperlink.label: Open Link
openPictureHyperlink.description: Follow the link on the picture.

deletePictureHyperlink.label: Remove Link
deletePictureHyperlink.description: Remove the link from the picture.
